text: Partly because more people can afford it, and partly because life has become busier. When both partners work long hours, cooking every evening is tiring, and a cheap café is a simple solution. Eating out has also become a social activity in itself — people meet friends over food rather than at home. The downside is that restaurant meals are often much less healthy.

tips.en: Partly because … and partly because … gives a clear structure.
tips.kk: Partly because … and partly because … — анық құрылым.
tips.ru: Partly because … and partly because … — ясная структура.
tips.example: partly because life has become busier

tips.en: The downside is … balances the answer briefly.
tips.kk: The downside is … — артық сөзсіз теңгерім.
tips.ru: The downside is … — баланс без лишних слов.
tips.example: The downside is that restaurant meals are often much less healthy

note.en: “A way of meeting people on its own”.

questions.question: Why do people eat out more often than they used to?

text: Not really, in my opinion. Burgers and sushi are popular, especially among teenagers, but traditional dishes are still at the centre of every celebration. What's interesting is that some young chefs now serve Kazakh dishes in a modern way, which makes them attractive to people who might otherwise choose pizza. So I'd say the two are growing side by side.

tips.en: Not really, in my opinion is a bold start followed by reasons.
tips.kk: Not really, in my opinion — батыл басталу, дәлелдер кейін.
tips.ru: Not really, in my opinion — смелый старт с доводами дальше.

tips.en: What's interesting is that … adds something new to the answer.
tips.kk: What's interesting is that … — жауап жаңа нәрсе қосады.
tips.ru: What's interesting is that … — ответ добавляет новое.
tips.example: What's interesting is that some young chefs now serve Kazakh dishes in a modern way

note.en: “Would choose if this did not exist”.

questions.question: Is traditional food in your country losing popularity to international food?

text: Definitely, especially in big cities. You can now get almost any kind of food in thirty minutes without leaving your sofa, which is convenient but also makes it tempting to order far too often. It has also changed how restaurants work — some kitchens now exist only for delivery and have no tables at all. I'd say people cook less and snack more as a result.

tips.en: Convenient but also tempting shows two effects in one sentence.
tips.kk: Convenient but also … tempting — бір сөйлемде екі әсер.
tips.ru: Convenient but also … tempting — два эффекта в одной фразе.
tips.example: which is convenient but also makes it tempting

tips.en: Kitchens only for delivery with no tables is a fresh detail.
tips.kk: Kitchens … only for delivery … no tables — жаңа дерек.
tips.ru: Kitchens … only for delivery … no tables — свежая деталь.
tips.example: some kitchens now exist only for delivery

note.en: “Eat small amounts between meals more often”.

questions.question: Has food delivery changed the way people eat?

text: I think showing calories on menus is a reasonable idea, because it helps people make informed choices without banning anything. Most people have no idea that a large coffee drink can contain as many calories as a meal. However, it shouldn't go too far — a small family café can't afford a laboratory analysis of every dish, so the rules should be simple.

tips.en: Informed choices without banning anything is an argument for freedom.
tips.kk: Informed choices without banning anything — еркіндік дәлелі.
tips.ru: Informed choices without banning anything — аргумент свободы.
tips.example: make informed choices without banning anything

tips.en: It shouldn't go too far shows concern for small businesses.
tips.kk: It shouldn't go too far — шағын бизнеске қамқорлық.
tips.ru: It shouldn't go too far — забота о маленьком бизнесе.

questions.followUp: Would you pay attention to it?
questions.question: Should restaurants be required to show how healthy their food is?

text: They've become very important. Most people I know check the rating before trying a new place, and a few bad reviews can seriously damage a small business. The problem is that reviews aren't always reliable — some are written by friends of the owner, and some by customers who were just in a bad mood. I usually read the most recent ones and ignore the extreme ones.

tips.kk: A few bad reviews can seriously damage … — пікірлердің күші.
tips.ru: A few bad reviews can seriously damage … — сила отзывов.
tips.example: a few bad reviews can seriously damage a small business
